about_the_game:
🎮 Welcome to Glitch Tower.

A gothic, dreamlike, and perpetually evolving 2D roguelike platformer with RPG and crafting elements — where the rules aren't just broken. they're glitched into oblivion.

Here, in this broken world, reality distorts, time is relative, and the sole constant is the climb.
You don't play a character, for you become a force tempered by time, nature, or chaos itself.

Choose your option:
🛡️ The unyielding Time Paladin
🌿 The untamed and ancient Centaur Druid
🧠 The volatile Glitch Mage
Both built with custom stat systems, hand-coded state machines, and unique idle animations, because in Glitch Tower, every detail matters.

The Tower evolves. The glitches compound. Built with a modular heart and a scalable mind, Glitch Tower evolves with you, a living project, forged by design, chaos, and code.

But beware:

  • No one ever escaped.

  • Not alive.

  • Not in one piece.

  • Not as the same person.

🧩 It's not a game. It's a test.
Of patience. Of perception. Of what you become when you're pushed.

There is no guiding hand. No map. No quarter.
Only discovery. Mastery. Disguise.

And there is always one rule that holds true:
⏳️ "Time judges. The Tower executes."

name: Glitch Tower

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended if you run lots of background apps)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 530 / UHD 630 or NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD RX 460 (≥2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM) - mid-range iGPUs like Iris Xe also fine
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: Glitch Tower is a precision 2D roguelike where every step can mutate the rules. Pick a hero, craft wild synergies from corrupted lists, and master fast combat. Bend the glitch, or be consumed. 🕰️ "Time judges. The Tower executes."
